faq.a: Balgees is associated with the Arabic form بلقيس, whose core sense is balqis (queen of sheba).

faq.q: What is the origin of Balgees?
faq.a: Balgees is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of بلقيس, the name traditionally given to the Queen of Sheba. The source record's gloss 'A servant of Allah' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form بلقيس is Arabic.
Balgees can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Balgees should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The Queen of Sheba is referred to in the Qur'an (27:23-44) but is not named there
